content.title: Product Color Chapters | Registered Geometry, Color Relay, Hero Lockup
content.summary: A field recorder rotates through five terrain-coded finishes before a lineup lockup. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One product geometry remains registered across every chapter. + Each chapter changes one color-and-light state only. + One readable exact color name accompanies each state. + Camera orbit and product axis remain consistent. + The final frame reunites product and full color range.
quick_start.recommended_input: Open a fictional portable field recorder named ORBIT on a charcoal product page with one centered three-quarter view. Move through exact SAND and SLATE chapters while body proportions, buttons and lens position remain registered. End on the complete ICE recorder beside a five-swatch lineup and the exact line CHOOSE YOUR SIGNAL.

usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.

applicable_scope: A field recorder rotates through five terrain-coded finishes before a lineup lockup. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
